preflight.estimateMethod: Actual adapter-shaped JSON body: UTF-8 bytes charged as input tokens, plus 4096 tokens per request for framing; maximum 8192 output tokens. Job IDs and versions padded above this workflow. No search/tools requested. Estimated bound, not billing measurement.
limitations: No live model quality result is established by this preflight.
Hosted review API returns parsed candidates and bounded token counters when available, not raw Meta envelopes or billed charges.
Local source snapshot hashes establish evaluator identity; they do not remotely attest deployed source.
Structured-rule equivalence and exact-source preservation are tested. Full quality of generated translations is not automatically scored.
preflight.executionGate: Wait for root/operator explicit live execution after payment, key setup and server enablement. This agent has no authorization to execute network requests.

evidenceScope: API calls to the owned hosted test site. Alice/Bob are simulated editors. Raw responses are own-site API responses containing hydrated rules, not raw Meta transport payloads. Corpus expected decisions are separate from model output.
usageLimitation: Review POST attempts are durably counted before dispatch. Numeric provider counters and durations are retained when available; billed cost is not measured. Room modelCallCount is an app counter, not a billing receipt. No retries or search.
qualityFailures: Site operation mosaic-corrected-review failed; recorded evidence; no retry was attempted.
